title: trigger_action_ability
description:
The active player triggers an action ability of one of their cards during an action window. Interrupt and reaction abilities are triggered with `trigger_interrupt_ability` and `trigger_reaction_ability`.

The engine does not apply card effects: the message only records which card is used. The player pays the costs and resolves the effects with other actions, then ends their opportunity to act (`end_opportunity`).

card_id.description: Card whose action ability is triggered.
